title: Attribution Proposal Approval
description: attribution-proposal-approval/v1 — the approver taking a proposed list, as a whole. The verdict is the EVENT TYPE rather than a field in here: a payload is opaque to a guard, so a rule that admits a posting only against an approved list can only be expressed if taking and refusing are different types. The event references the proposal it decides, and that reference is what a guard reads; the fields below restate it for readers of the log.

reportId.description: The report the approved proposal belongs to.

proposalId.description: The proposal being approved. The event also references the proposal event itself, which is the protocol-level counterpart of this field.

note.description: Free-text remark from the approver. An approval needs no justification, so this is informational.

by.description: The emitting ORGANIZATION. Agreement events carry a role rather than an org, so the document pins the organization.
